name: Elixir of Suffering
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon prepares a brew meant to kill the living. He needs animal reagents from the surrounding foothills.

sections.title: A Toxic Enterprise
sections.body: Tarren Mill is a Forsaken stronghold in the Hillsbrad Foothills and a research station for the Royal Apothecary Society. Apothecary Lydon works there, surrounded by green countryside he despises. He longs to see human settlements poisoned and conquered. For his experimental Elixir of Suffering, he needs potent, virulent ingredients from nearby creatures.

sections.title: Gathering Reagents
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon sends hunters into the wilds around Tarren Mill for Gray Bear tongues and the rare ichor of Moss Creepers. Unholy alchemy refines these animal substances into the base of a lethal mixture. He means it to kill living trespassers across Hillsbrad.

faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society and is stationed in Tarren Mill. He despises Hillsbrad's living landscape and works to make potent poisons against human populations.

faq.q: Why does Lydon need bear tongues and creeper ichor?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon needs Gray Bear tongues and Moss Creeper ichor for his lethal brews. Their biological properties provide the alchemical base for his Elixir of Suffering.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
aliases: what happens after elixir of suffering
faq.answer: Once Apothecary Lydon receives the ingredients, he blends them into a prototype brew. Then he demands that it be tested on living subjects for its lethal effect.

faq.q: What is the goal of the Royal Apothecary Society in Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: Under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's command, the Royal Apothecary Society seeks an alchemical plague to wipe out humanity and the Scourge alike. Tarren Mill is a frontier outpost where they gather biological matter and test prototypes against local Alliance forces.

faq.q: Where can the necessary creatures be found?
faq.answer: Gray Bears roam the central fields and forests of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Moss Creepers lurk in brush and wooded areas just outside Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Why is Lydon in such a bad mood?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon is disgusted by vitality, clean air and thriving nature. He finds joy in death, decay and distilling deadly toxins.

angles.text: As a Forsaken operative, you can help advance the Royal Apothecary Society's aim to create a devastating weapon for the survival of your people against living humanity.
As a Horde ally, you may balk at the Forsaken's ruthless biological experiments. Tarren Mill's frontier against Southshore depends on their alchemical warfare.
